title: Ron K NDE 32286
content: Before I went over, I said, 'Get a doctor.' The blood was flowing pretty freely. They said it won't help. I said some goodbyes in effect then again said, 'Get a doctor, I need to save my blood.' Then I went unconscious. They told me I did literally just stop right after making the statement. I was young. My Mom was several thousand miles away and, I ran in spirit to her. She told me years later I was there as a blue light, about 5' above floor, and she knew it was me. She realized immediately that I must have died. She said I followed her around her home. I recall following her. I could hear her words, she could get my meanings well. I said my goodbyes to her. My experience was leaving the planet. I was very aware I was in space. I headed to the brightest area, where it all flows from. Getting closer, a group came out quickly and as I past them they called me and said they had a message. We talked for a long time, then I was asked to go back. I did not want to go back and it was understood by all that I did not have to. One of them identified himself as a friend of one of the person who had rescued me and was in room when I went over. A woman assured me that if I went back, I would have three children...the list of things to do did not matter so much to me, but the kids did. So, I went back. I recall looking over the body where it lay and saw those around in room. It was awful going back into the body..rotten worm filled thing.... I guess I am used to it again. All the people I talked to were as transparent/3D Outline of naked selves in bluish/white light. Their facial features were very distinguishable.

arrival.other_being_detail: A group of beings appeared; one identified himself as a friend of a person who rescued the experiencer; a woman in the group assured him he would have three children if he returned.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described leaving the planet, being in space, and heading to 'the brightest area, where it all flows from.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He was asked to go back; he then 'went back' and recalled looking over the body and re-entering it.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Not specified beyond heavy blood loss and going unconscious after asking for a doctor.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Included apparent veridical visit to mother as a 'blue light' and travel into space toward a brightest area, then return to body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE included traveling to his mother (distant) before leaving the planet into space and meeting a group near a brightest area; later returned and viewed body before re-entering.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported traveling 'in spirit' to his mother thousands of miles away as a 'blue light' that she perceived; beings described as transparent '3D Outline of naked selves in bluish/white light.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “She told me years later I was there as a blue light, about 5' above floor, and she knew it was me.” / “My experience was leaving the planet. I was very aware I was in space.” / “It was awful going back into the body..rotten worm filled thing....”
